page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Title heading centred below. One engraved emblem in a framed box, centred. Four lines of verse centred below the engraving. Catchword at bottom right.

p.i: Dulce ut amicitiæ nomen, sic dulcior usus, Nil equidem patulus carius orbis habet. Unus sit Pylades fido tibi fidus Oresti Hic quoq; amicitiæ non levis usus erit.

page.notes: The engraving is not transcribed as text. It shows two arms clasping hands, with a star above them, two crossed arrows or stalks, an hourglass, a clock dial, a key and a padlock hanging from a loop of chain, and a hilly landscape. The page number reads "212" but the first digit is worn and could be read differently ([?]). The verse is set in italic. The "u" and "v" letters were normalised to the vowel/consonant rule. The catchword "Omnium" is printed in bold italic at the lower right.
